accepted.reason: The HTTP server's tenant authorization (any authenticated user, any tenant). Eregion runs chromadb embedded (chromadb.PersistentClient in glorfindel/memory.py and analysis/campaign_report.py): no chromadb server is started nor exposed, no tenant, no authentication. No fixed version yet (1.5.9 locked).

Code run on the HTTP server through a collection update (/api/v2/..., UPDATE_COLLECTION). Eregion runs chromadb embedded (PersistentClient): no chromadb server, no HTTP API reachable, and no collection configured with trust_remote_code. No fixed version yet (1.5.9 locked).

Code run on the HTTP server before authentication, through its collections endpoint. Eregion runs chromadb embedded (PersistentClient): no chromadb server is started nor exposed, no endpoint to reach. No fixed version yet (1.5.9 locked).

The HTTP server's SimpleRBACAuthorizationProvider ignores the tenant, database or collection of a permission. Eregion runs chromadb embedded (PersistentClient): no server, no authorization provider configured. No fixed version yet (1.5.9 locked).

Regular-expression denial of service in TraceContextTextMapPropagator.extract() on a forged traceparent value. Eregion does not reach it: the package comes only as a dependency (of anthropic, chromadb, fastapi; requirements/glorfindel.txt, requirements/dev.txt), no line of Eregion imports opentelemetry, no OpenTelemetry instrumentation package is in the locks, and nothing configures a tracer provider, so no propagator reads an incoming header (FastAPI's native telemetry and chromadb's tracing stay off without one). The slow path needs a line feed inside the value, which a conforming HTTP header cannot carry (h11 and httptools refuse it). Fixed in 1.45.2 (1.45.1 locked): it comes with the next make lock, no bump for this advisory alone.
